count_definitions.text_chars: Characters in extracted page text, including whitespace; not an OCR quality score.
count_definitions.image_count: Displayed image occurrences, including inline images; repeated uses count separately.
count_definitions.vector_drawing_count: Extracted vector drawing paths; text is counted separately.
count_definitions.fonts: Page font resources, which may include unused fonts.

limitations: Structural checks do not verify OCR accuracy, reading order, completeness, or agreement with a source scan. Visual review is still required.
Text, image, and drawing counts do not establish that a PDF is fully vectorized. Text can be invisible, and images can be appropriate photographs or illustrations.
Text bounds are extraction metrics with a 2-point tolerance; they do not prove visual clipping, overlap, legibility, or correct layout.
Font checks inspect page font resources, including resources that may be unused. An embedded font does not establish correct glyph mapping or rendering.
Link checks do not use the network, execute actions, or recursively audit linked documents. External files are checked only within an explicit --links-root.
